cohort: 422 mothers residing in the Al-Baha region, Saudi Arabia, who had access to social media
finding: The study found that GDM was associated with an increased risk of several adverse pregnancy outcomes, including eclampsia, thyroid problems, postpartum hemorrhage, shorter pregnancy durations, higher cesarean section rates, and an increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes post pregnancy.
mod_finding: The study found that GDM was associated with higher cesarean section rates.
